target.title: fix: keep always-on group fallback messages in dispatch
target.body:
﻿Closes #99457

AI-assisted PR.

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users with always-on group routes could have ordinary unmentioned group messages dropped after a plugin-bound conversation fell back with `missing_plugin` or `no_handler`.

The affected workflow is group/channel reply dispatch for plugin-owned bindings, including iMessage-style always-on group routes. Mention-required groups should still stay quiet for unmentioned chatter, but always-on groups should continue into the normal agent dispatch path.

## Why This Change Was Made

The plugin-bound fallback branch was checking only the raw `WasMentioned === false` flag before returning. This change reuses the existing `resolveGroupRequireMention(...)` policy resolver before suppressing an unmentioned group/channel fallback, so the early return only applies when the effective group policy actually requires a mention.

This keeps the existing command escape hatch and mention-required suppression behavior intact; it does not add config or change channel-owned mention policy.

Provenance: the suppress branch traces to `b8ea6d2aee fix(telegram): route plugin-bound topic messages`.

## User Impact

Always-on group routes can now preserve unmentioned plugin-bound fallback messages in the agent/session path instead of silently dropping them. Mention-required groups continue to suppress ordinary unmentioned messages.

## Evidence

TDD RED before restoring the production fix:

```text
node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.auto-reply.config.ts src/auto-reply/reply/dispatch-from-config.test.ts -t "dispatches unmentioned plugin-bound fallback in always-on groups"
FAIL: expected replyResolver to be called once, but got 0 times
```

Passing local proof after the fix:

```text
node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.auto-reply.config.ts src/auto-reply/reply/dispatch-from-config.test.ts -t "dispatches unmentioned plugin-bound fallback|keeps unmentioned plugin-bound fallback|lets authorized control commands without CommandSource escape plugin-bound fallback"
Test Files 1 passed; Tests 3 passed
```

```text
node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.auto-reply.config.ts src/auto-reply/inbound.test.ts
Test Files 1 passed; Tests 61 passed
```

```text
pnpm exec oxfmt --check --threads=1 src/auto-reply/reply/dispatch-from-config.ts src/auto-reply/reply/dispatch-from-config.test.ts
All matched files use the correct format.
```

```text
exit 0

pnpm tsgo:core

git diff --check
exit 0
```

Additional notes:

- Local full raw Vitest for `src/auto-reply/reply/dispatch-from-config.test.ts` on Windows hit two pre-existing path-separator assertions around `.openclaw/workspace` and staged media metadata; targeted affected cases pass locally, and CI/Linux should provide the full-file signal.

- `python .agents\skills\autoreview\scripts\autoreview --mode local` was attempted with `PYTHONUTF8=1`; the Codex reviewer started but returned a usage-limit error before findings were produced. No autoreview result is claimed.
